notes:
## New

- List friends who are playing first and remember the order
- Add a mini grid view
- Clear completed downloads from the list
- Link an Epic Games account and sync owned games, playtime and achievements
- What's new panel with release notes written from the commits since the last version
- Show tier badges on every platform, in the game hero and library

## Fixed

- Batch Datanodes checks in one window and rank Datanodes last
- Count GOG and Epic playtime for the review gate and Big Picture profile
- Keep a new sync's cancel flag when the previous sync finishes
- Retry failed lookups after 5 minutes and skip requests for cards that left the screen

## Faster

- Keep ProtonDB answers on disk for a week
- Open game pages from cache and prefetch on hover
